title: Volvo FH FUPS Aluminium Bullbar w/- Road Train signs #13
description: FH series Volvo heavy duty radar compatible FUPS hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Features 160mm deep skirt and 76mm heavy duty wall tube. Heavy duty mesh in front of the grill and channel to protect lower lights. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs shown. Optional spotlight mounts as requires. Dual steel tow pins mounted in heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate. Dual Roo-cutters to protect headlights. Indicator repeaters in outer box uprights.
